title: Affine coefficient ideal for containment of a finite locally free subscheme
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring [def-pc-scheme], let $B$ be an $R$-algebra that is finite projective as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], and let $J\subseteq B$ be an ideal. Let $K\subseteq R$ be the ideal generated by all $\varphi(j)$ with $j\in J$ and $\varphi\in\operatorname{Hom}_R(B,R)$. Then for every ring map $R\to R'$, the image of $J$ in $B\otimes_R R'$ is zero if and only if the image of $K$ in $R'$ is zero.

source.place: Picard Schemes of Curves, Lemma 44.2.7, label lemma-hilb-d-of-closed, Tag 0B97

proof.text: Because $B$ is finite projective, choose a finite dual system $(b_a,\varphi_a)$ with $b=\sum_a\varphi_a(b)b_a$ for every $b\in B$, where $\varphi_a\in\operatorname{Hom}_R(B,R)$. Define $K$ to be the ideal generated by all coefficients $\varphi(j)$ for $j\in J$ and $\varphi\in\operatorname{Hom}_R(B,R)$, as in the statement. The dual-system identity is obtained by writing $B$ as a direct summand of a finite free module and restricting the standard dual basis.

source.place: Picard Schemes of Curves, Lemma 44.2.7, label lemma-hilb-d-of-closed, Tag 0B97 (affine coefficient construction)

proof.text: Let $\rho:R\to R'$ be a ring map. If the image of $J$ in $B\otimes_R R'$ is zero, then for every $j\in J$ and every $R$-linear functional $\varphi:B\to R$, the induced $R'$-linear map $B\otimes_R R'\to R'$ sends $j\otimes1$ to $\rho(\varphi(j))$, so every generator of $K$ maps to zero in $R'$.

source.place: Picard Schemes of Curves, Lemma 44.2.7, label lemma-hilb-d-of-closed, Tag 0B97 (affine coefficient construction)

proof.text: Thus the image of $K$ in $R'$ is zero whenever the image of $J$ is zero.

source.place: Picard Schemes of Curves, Lemma 44.2.7, label lemma-hilb-d-of-closed, Tag 0B97 (affine coefficient construction)

proof.text: Conversely, suppose the image of $K$ in $R'$ is zero. For $j\in J$, tensor the dual-system identity from Step 1 with $R'$ to obtain $j\otimes1=\sum_a (\varphi_a(j)\otimes1)(b_a\otimes1)$. Each coefficient $\varphi_a(j)\otimes1$ is zero because it is the image of a generator of $K$, so $j\otimes1=0$. This holds for all $j\in J$, exactly saying that the image of $J$ in $B\otimes_R R'$ is zero.

source.place: Picard Schemes of Curves, Lemma 44.2.7, label lemma-hilb-d-of-closed, Tag 0B97 (affine coefficient construction)
